digest.component_or_area: complexity analysis and code quality gate
propositions: A repository-wide function complexity baseline must be established at max-complexity=15 to prevent regression of production code (`src/rebar`) without blocking existing commits on current debt.
The wrapper script must accept live C901 findings from Ruff, compare them against a committed JSON baseline by qualified AST symbol, and fail only on new or increased complexity (shrink-only gate).
The baseline JSON schema must enforce strict validation (schema_version, sorted keys, qualified symbols, integer ceilings >15) and reject duplicates, malformed entries, and unknown fields.

Maintenance mode (`--update-stale`) must atomically lower or remove stale ceilings through fsutil.atomic_write, refuse to write for new/increased debt or scanner errors, and report no byte changes when no stale entry exists.
The `make lint` target must wire the complexity wrapper check over production scope while retaining existing Ruff and format checks over both `src` and `tests`.
